notes: Research conducted 2026-11-13 via web search; many H2-2026 figures come from secondary/aggregator outlets relaying Reuters, Bloomberg, CNBC, FT, The Information, WSJ. Spot-check headline numbers before publishing.

Anthropic overtook OpenAI in both valuation ($965B vs $852B, May 2026) and recognized revenue (Q2 2026: $11.6B vs $6.7B) and is days from a Nasdaq IPO (pricing expected 2026-11-18). IPO terms are indicative until priced.
OpenAI vs Anthropic run-rates are NOT like-for-like: OpenAI reports net of cloud-partner share (~$50B, Sep 2026), Anthropic gross (~$81B, Oct 2026).

Headline net losses for both labs are dominated by non-cash fair-value charges (OpenAI 2025: ~$30B of $38.5B; Anthropic 9M 2026: $94.3B of $104B). Operating loss and cash flow are the more meaningful series.
Negative values in 'losses' entries with metric operating_loss / operating_cash_outflow denote a PROFIT / cash inflow (see each note).
Compute-commitment totals mix different concepts (take-or-pay minimums, leases, 'up to' amounts, analyst estimates). Do not sum counterparties.

Not found (null): total funding for Mistral, Perplexity, Cursor, Lovable, Runway, Scale, Databricks, Harvey, Sierra, Glean, Hugging Face, Chinese labs; revenue for Figure, Hugging Face, DeepSeek, SSI/TML; USD IPO proceeds for Zhipu and MiniMax; burn figures for most app-layer startups; xAI standalone financials after the SpaceX merger.

Three of the listed companies are no longer independent private startups: xAI (merged into SpaceX, Feb 2026), Cursor (acquired by SpaceX, June 2026), Character.AI (Chapter 11, Oct 2026). Zhipu and MiniMax are public in Hong Kong; Anthropic is mid-IPO.
